The data is the git tree at f341af69 (git trees API, not truncated): 957 blobs, 16,997,212 bytes; 950 JSON logs under data/<run set>/local/<suite>/<task dir>/<attack dir>/<file>.json, 15,674,195 bytes, 2,188 to 84,567 bytes per file, 950 distinct blob SHAs (0 byte-identical pairs); non-log blobs LICENSE 1,066, README.md 2,246, recompute_agentdojo.py 2,547 and 4 PNGs 1,317,158 bytes. Agrees with the profile pin (commit f341af69, expected_files 957; 953 non-image files 15,680,054 bytes = 15,674,195 + 1,066 + 2,246 + 2,547) and the phase-10c census (all_tree_entries 957, json_blobs 950, 4 absent PNG blobs). Per cell from the listing: ad_full_attack/workspace 560 attacked + 14 pre-pass; ad_full_benign/workspace 40; ad_tb_attack banking 144 + 9, travel 140 + 7; ad_tb_benign banking 16, travel 20; no (suite, task dir, file) key in both run sets.
harness: AgentDojo, logs say agentdojo_package_version 0.1.35 in all 950 (phase-10c census), which names the distribution, not the code (release v0.1.35 = a75aba76, 2025-10-27; main kept 0.1.35 through 089ed468, 2026-06-02); installation not declared (profile code_identity 'unpinned'). Benchmark v1.2.2 in all 950 (census), suites workspace, banking, travel only (no slack). pipeline_name 'local' = AgentDojo's LocalLLM element (OpenAI-compatible client, prompt-based <function=...> tool calls, call ids null; MODEL_NAMES['local'] = 'Local model' at a75aba76). Known bugs of this code that bear on the logs: LocalLLM parses only the first tool tag per completion (#150); drops fenced or invalid-JSON calls and ends the turn (#202, #219: attacks under-counted); turns server errors into an empty final answer scored as failed task and failed attack (#220); no max_tokens cap (#202). Benchmark: workspace injection_task_6..13 have an empty ground_truth in v1.2.2 (#213), so tool_knowledge injections for them carry no tool instructions (ToolKnowledgeAttack builds its text from ground_truth placeholder_args, important_instructions_attacks.py l.113-131 at a75aba76 [corrected from l.111-130]); banking injection_task_0/1/3 security reduces to 'any transfer to the attacker IBAN' through an operator-precedence bug (#181); the runner returns security True for every run without an injection task (benign and pre-pass; artefacts.toml agentdojo.art.benign_security_constant). TraceLogger keeps only the last of up to 3 passes and a naive evaluation_timestamp.
models: deepseek-v4-flash (DeepSeek) per the README line 9 at the pin only; no log names a model (pipeline_name 'local'); identity table row class I (D-92, D-105, D-106). The same line named 'DeepSeek V4 Pro / J-Space' at 47a44d18, 1 h 43 min earlier
